title: Rabbi Acha bar Gamda
author: Aharon Hyman
attribution: Model-assisted translation, editorially reviewed; publication authorized by Joshua Waxman.
copyright: English translation and editorial notes © 2026 Joshua Waxman. All rights reserved.
paragraphs: He is mentioned in Yalkut, Mishlei, end of remez 932: “Rabbi Acha bar Gamda said that Rabbi Simai said: Scripture says, ‘The discipline [of the Lord]…,’” etc. Hyman calls this a scribal error and traces it to Megillah 31b, where “Rabbi Chiyya bar Gamda said that Rabbi Assi said,” and so it is in Jerusalem Talmud Megillah 4:5, Rabbi Chiyya bar Gamda.
